Hi David,

Thanks for sending the form in, and for confirming the unit was never overclocked. That matters, it keeps the warranty fully intact.

Your RMA request is in and sitting with JD, our hardware lead, for sign off. That is the last step before the return opens. Once it is approved I buy the prepaid label myself and send you the link right here in this thread, so there is nothing else for you to do or submit.

A couple of things so you are ready. The return reference will be Shop····, and I will ask you to write that clearly on the outside of the box. The unit goes back to our Chattanooga warehouse on a USPS Ground label we pay for. Your replacement is the same NerdOctaxe at no cost, and it is reserved and held for you as soon as the approval lands, then ships once your faulty unit reaches us.

The team is offline right now and picks this up today at 10am Eastern. I will write back here the moment it is approved, so watch this thread.

Sorry you have been chasing this one, David. I will stay on it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
no worres, thanks for all of your assistance!

Hi David,

You are very welcome. Nothing more is needed from you for now.

I will write back in this thread as soon as the RMA is signed off, with your prepaid label and the return reference, Shop····. If anything changes in the meantime, just reply here.

Thanks for your patience with this one.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
